activity.notes: The Mujibnagar government named Sheikh Mujibur Rahman President of Bangladesh while he was imprisoned in Pakistan, with Syed Nazrul Islam serving as Acting President. Banglapedia's presidential chronology records Mujib's first presidential tenure from 17 April 1971 to 12 January 1972. The 10 April Proclamation of Independence deemed the constitutional order effective from 26 March, but ATLAS uses the formal government-in-exile office chronology rather than backdating the personal term.
